decisions.text: behaviour: chips are not given the `data-quick` attribute (they use `data-chip`), so `e2e/011-4-reorder.spec.ts` keeps counting only grid buttons — reverse: rename the attribute
behaviour: the chip title for sleep is always the 'start sleep' title; a running sleep shows only the filled moon and a red border — reverse: use `sleepButtonEnd` when a sleep is open
behaviour: a stored `quickActionsMinimized` with an unknown or repeated id keeps the valid ids on read; a PUT with such a value is 400 — reverse: ignore the whole stored value as the other fields do

behaviour: a hand-typed minute such as 07:43 is shown as the selected cell only when it falls on a 5-minute step; the box does not mark other minutes — reverse: highlight the nearest step in datetime24.html

behaviour: picking an hour keeps the current minutes and moves to the minute grid, so the value changes after the hour tap; ביטול then leaves the picked hour in place — reverse: hold both picks in the box and emit only on the minute tap
behaviour: the old calendar chip's fixed icon in datetime24.html got an icon-slot-exception comment to pass the kit check — reverse: give it a slot and regenerate the icon names
behaviour: the reaction form no longer uses the device's local time; its time is Asia/Jerusalem like the Tracker — reverse: convert with the device's own zone in reaction-form.ts

behaviour: scope extended to docs/brain/inventory.md, regenerated by node scripts/inventory.mjs because adding the default made the kit check inventory-stale fail — reverse: drop that file from the commit, then the kit check fails again
